title: Adjuvant VaccInation After Conization for the Treatment for CervicAL Dysplasia
official: The Role of Adjuvant VaccInation After Conization for the Treatment for Cervical Dysplasia
summary: HPV vaccination has emerged as a strategy to reduce the risk of recurrence oafter excisional treatment. However, only few data are aviable. In this trial the investigators aim to assess the role of HPV vaccination in women traeted for HPV-related lesions
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Treatment of HPV-related disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous HPV vaccination
